messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] green cluster for service=edge-proxy (v2.11.0) finished rollout in eu-west at 21:10 UTC — starting health checks.

anna: getting pages about 502s from EU customers, looks like errors peaked right after the switch.

chris: seeing lots of TLS handshake failures on edge-proxy-green behind the CDN. 502s returned from our origin.

mike: can someone paste a sample error from the edge logs? I only see successful handoffs in the control plane.

sarah: pasting tail from the edge node in eu-west-3: 
```
[2024-11-04T21:11:04Z] edge-proxy-green tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
[2024-11-04T21:11:05Z] upstream connect failed: 502, connection refused
[2024-11-04T21:11:05Z] route=/inference gen_request_id=abc123 status=502
```

chris: oh — cert on the green instances has CN for "edge.internal" but our CDN expects SANs that include "*.redwood.ai" since we rotated the wildcard cert earlier. green was built from the canary AMI that missed the cert sync job.

anna: confirmed via SSH: /etc/ssl/certs/edge.pem is the older cert on green. It expired SANs for the CDN.

ops: Paging on-call for infra: @chris you were already pinged but can you confirm if we can hotpatch the cert or we need full rollback?

chris: hotpatch path exists but it's risky — need to reissue and restart edge-proxy on all green instances, will cause short connection drops. Given customer impact is high, prefer kill-switch / immediate rollback to blue.

mike: agreement from runtime: automatic fallback to blue isn't fully enabled for this route due to a recent routing-opt change (PR #682). We have to do manual traffic flip.

sarah: status check: support reports ~12 distinct customers in EU experiencing degraded responses over the last 6 minutes, some product features failing. Severity looks like P1.

support-lead: adding context — three customers (ids: C-1024, C-2231, C-3120) reported 502s in critical user flows, affecting production. They're being paged.

anna: action plan — 1) Kill rollout by flipping traffic back to blue (manual) 2) add temporary redirect/maintenance page if needed 3) follow-up hotpatch during off-peak to fix certs and re-roll green.

mike: commands to flip: 
```bash
# switch weights from green->blue for eu-west routing pool
redwood infra route-set traffic --pool eu-west --service edge-proxy --variant blue --weight 100
```

chris: executing now. I'll apply and monitor healthchecks.

deploy-bot: runbook action initiated by chris: route-change requested (ticket 54821).

sarah: seeing traffic shift starting at 21:14:15 UTC. Error rate dropping.

anna: confirming with curl from an external probe: 
```bash
curl -I https://eu.edge.redwood.ai/health 
HTTP/2 200
content-type: application/json
```

support-lead: customers reporting recovery within ~2–3 minutes of the flip. We'll keep them in the loop.

mike: for the post-incident: immediate fix is to add a cert-sanity check in the AMI baking process + gating the CDN SAN check in the deploy pipeline. Also revert the routing-opt change that removed auto-fallback.

chris: noting root cause: AMI bake job skipped cert-sync because the cert-manager service was temporarily misconfigured during that bake window. Two independent failures aligned: bad AMI + routing-opt removed fallback.

sarah: severity P1 declared. Notifying on-call rotation and paging channel. Ticket created: INC-2024-54821.

deploy-bot: @pagerduty-bot routed alert to oncall (anna) at 21:15 UTC — acknowledgement from anna.

anna: handing off to chris for infra fixes. I'm going offline in 15 for dinner, will be available if needed.

chris: starting AMI re-bake including cert-sync and an integration check that verifies CDN SANs. ETA 45m. I'll mark the rollback complete in the routing runbook.

support-lead: I'll follow up with affected customers: summary, timeline, mitigation, and that we're treating as P1.

mike: quick mitigation note — re-enable auto-fallback in canary config (revert PR #682) in a dev deploy, then promote after verification. That avoids manual flips in future.

anna: thank you all. Postmortem owners: chris (infra root cause & bake fixes), mike (runtime fallback), sarah (incident ops & comms).

deploy-bot: incident state: mitigated. next steps: postmortem scheduled, fix PRs to be linked to INC-2024-54821.

ops: leaving a short checklist for follow-up: [ ] revert routing-opt PR, [ ] add AMI cert-sanity gate, [ ] update runbook with cert rotation checks, [ ] run a canary that verifies CDN handshake.

sarah: last note — please add the exact list of affected customer IDs to the incident ticket for billing/credit reviews.

anna: marking this thread resolved from on-call perspective; if anything regress, re-open. :white_check_mark: 

chris: thanks — will post fix PR numbers and AMI bake ID in INC ticket when done.

support-lead: closing customer notifications loop — they've acknowledged and appreciate the quick rollback.

mike: assigning postmortem draft to chris and sarah.

deploy-bot: incident closed at 21:33 UTC.
